# Notion OAuth Requirements Quality Checklist: Fix Found Bugs — BUG-001

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the BUG-001 requirements — are they complete, clear, consistent and measurable enough to write tasks and tests from, with emphasis on the OAuth/security surface and on failure and recovery flows
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/notion-api.md](../contracts/notion-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer, before `/speckit-tasks`. Scope: BUG-001 only; the Bug Register's own process is covered in one section at the end.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does a functional requirement (not only an edge case) state what happens to the chosen database and sync position when a user reconnects to a different workspace? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does FR-001.8 state whether the connection is kept when no pages were shared, or discarded until the user reconnects? [Gap, Spec §FR-001.8, Plan R6]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the behaviour of connections created before this fix (no renewal credential) stated as a requirement rather than only as an assumption? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-001.9]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified whether a user who is asked to sign in before connecting is returned to Connectors afterwards, or has to start the connect flow again? [Gap, Spec §US2 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for what the user sees when revoking access at Notion fails during Disconnect (silent, or a notice)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001.10]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are loading states for Connectors specified while the connection status is being fetched, alongside the unavailable, not-connected, connected and reconnect-needed states? [Completeness, Spec §US1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the unavailable-state copy fixed, or is "(or equivalent copy)" left open, and if open, what must it convey? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "a small indicator on the dashboard" defined by where it appears, what it says and what it links to? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001.9, Clarifications Q4]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "a structured 'unavailable' response" defined precisely enough to test (status and error code), or is that left entirely to the contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001.1, Contract §Error envelope]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "a specific, readable error" in FR-001.3 defined by the message and code the user receives? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001.3]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "within one sync cycle" in SC-001.4 tied to a stated cycle length, so the criterion has a time bound? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001.4]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "best effort" for revocation bounded (how long the dashboard waits before giving up)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001.10, Plan R8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Do the connection statuses listed in Key Entities (connected, reconnect needed, disconnected) match the plan's status model, which also keeps a transient `error` status? [Conflict, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §Status transitions]
- [ ] CHK014 - Do the spec and plan agree on preview environments: the spec's edge case says previews use the mocked Notion, while the plan says previews set no credentials and show the unavailable state? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan R11]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the outcome for a replayed connect-return link the same in the spec ("rejected and nothing changes") and the contract (outcome `expired` with its message)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §callback]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the cancelled-consent message's neutral styling (Story 3 scenario 1) consistent with how the other outcomes are styled, and is that difference stated for every outcome? [Consistency, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does FR-001.12's list of logged events (failed exchange, failed renewal, refused access) match the plan's, which also logs revoke outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001.12, Plan R10]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Does SC-001.2 say who measures the one-minute connect time, on which environment, and how many attempts count as a pass? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001.2]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does SC-001.5 define which routes "all routes" covers — API routes only, or also page routes that should legitimately return a web page? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001.5]
- [ ] CHK020 - Does every functional requirement FR-001.1 to FR-001.12 trace to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the point at which BUG-001 counts as "Fixed" defined in the spec (merged, deployed, or passing the staging smoke), rather than only in the quickstart? [Gap, Spec §How this spec works, Quickstart §Done]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for a user who starts two connect attempts at once (two tabs), where the second overwrites the first? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for a user whose sign-in session expires while they are on Notion's consent screen? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the recovery path from `reconnect_needed` fully specified, including whether sync catches up on changes made while it was paused? [Recovery, Spec §US4 scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for Notion rate-limiting or being slow during the no-pages check right after consent? [Exception Flow, Gap, Plan R6]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the behaviour specified when a user deletes their dashboard account while a Notion connection exists (revoke at Notion, or local deletion only)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are the security properties of the connect attempt (bound to the user who started it, single use, expiry) all stated as requirements, not left to the plan? [Security, Spec §FR-001.6]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is it stated that the renewal credential gets the same protection as the access credential at rest and on disconnect? [Security, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-001.10]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are accessibility requirements specified for the new states and messages (announced to screen readers, keyboard reachable Try again and Reconnect actions)? [Gap, Accessibility]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is it specified how long failure logs containing user ids are kept, and whether a user id counts as personal data under the project's privacy stance? [Gap, Privacy, Spec §FR-001.12]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the assumption that Notion's current OAuth behaviour (refresh token, revoke endpoint, `access_denied`) holds for the Notion API version the project targets (`2025-09-03`) recorded and checkable? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the owner dependency (creating the Notion public integration, its name while ADR-0002 is open, and its privacy and terms pages) listed with what is blocked until it is done? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is it stated which stories can be accepted without the owner dependency (1, 3, 4 with the mocked Notion) and which cannot (2)? [Dependency, Spec §US2]

## Bug Register Process

- [ ] CHK034 - Is a severity scale defined (what makes a bug High versus Medium or Low) so future entries are rated consistently? [Gap, Spec §Bug Register]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are the required parts of a new bug entry (register row, diagnosis, stories, FR/SC numbering) stated as a template that later entries must follow? [Completeness, Spec §How this spec works]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK013 and CHK014 are real conflicts between spec and plan found while generating this list; resolve them before `/speckit-tasks`
